# AI TOP 100E SSD 1TB

## Key Features

### Extend your AI capabilities with the AI TOP 100E SSD 

 Maximize your AI capabilities with the AI TOP 100E SSD, designed to effortlessly handle the most demanding tasks, improve endurance and boost responsiveness for AI workloads. It’s a smart investment to accelerate data processing and boost productivity.​ 

### KEY FEATURE 

- M.2 2280, PCle 4.0 x4 interface, NVMe 1.4​ 
- Expand memory pool for AI models or contents​ 
- Outstanding TBW (Terabytes Written) for workload scenarios of Al training.​ 
- SMART & TRIM support​ 
- LDPC (Low Density Parity Check) of ECC algorithm supports​ 
- 5 years limited lifetime warranty 

 

### Break the Barriers of VRAM and System DRAM Limitations​ 

 ​VRAM and system DRAM often become bottlenecks when training an AI model due to their limited capacity and high costs. Using the AI TOP utility, you can offload the processing of large datasets from VRAM or DRAM to the AI TOP 100E SSD, effectively enlarging your memory pool and upgrading the capability to fine-tune large AI models. This approach enhances performance and significantly lowers the total cost of ownership (TCO), with the AI TOP 100E SSD emerging as the most cost-effective option per gigabyte compared to VRAM and system DRAM.​ 

 ✨Using the AI TOP utility can effectively expand the memory pool. 

### Outstanding TBW rating 

 Due to the extensive data writing involved, SSD lifespan can be a concern. However, the AI TOP 100E SSD is designed exclusively for intensive AI workloads and has a 150 times higher TBW rating than standard SSDs. 

 

### Unparalleled speed for your AI applications​ 

 Transform your AI capabilities with the AI TOP 100E SSD, whose sequential read/write speeds reach an impressive 7200/6500 MB/s. Designed to handle even the most demanding tasks with ease, the AI TOP 100E SSD ensures your data is processed quickly and efficiently.​

### Your Complete Local AI Solution

AI TOP is GIGABYTE’s complete hardware and software solution for local AI development. Run open-source models efficiently with advanced memory offloading, while keeping your data safe and secure on your desktop.

### Memory Offloading

Expand capacity by offloading data to system memory and SSDs — train up to 685B-parameter models with optimized memory management.

### SSD Mounting

Automatically mount 1–2 NVMe SSDs to offload training memory, improving speed and stability.

#### AI TOP Motherboard

Tailored for AI workloads with the optimal CPU, GPU, memory, and SSD support.

#### AI TOP Graphics Card

Engineered for AI performance with optimal cooling, Ultra Durable reliability, and ample VRAM.

#### AI TOP SSD

109,500 TBW endurance with RAID support, 20x more durable than enterprise SSDs for reliable AI workloads.

#### AI TOP PSU

High-wattage ATX 3.1 and PCIe 5.1-ready power for multi-GPU setups with real-time power monitoring.

#### AI TOP PC

### AI TOP PC

Pre-built systems ready to deploy straight out of the box for projects of any scale. Boost performance with AI TOP Clustering Technology by linking multiple units via Ethernet or Thunderbolt for larger workloads.

- 10GbE for long-distance clustering
- Thunderbolt 4 support

...

- What is GIGABYTE AI TOP? 

Introduced at COMPUTEX 2024, GIGABYTE AI TOP is a complete desktop solution for local AI development. By combining AI TOP Utility software with AI TOP Hardware, it lets you “Create Your Own AI on Your Desk.” With support for models up to 685B parameters, it delivers enterprise-grade performance while running on standard power.

...

- What are the system requirements for running AI TOP Utility?

AI TOP Utility is designed to run on the AI TOP Hardware. It works with Linux and Windows Subsystem for Linux (WSL2) on Windows 11. See the [supported hardware list] for full compatibility.

...

The AI TOP Hardware is GIGABYTE's ecosystem of components and systems designed for AI workloads, including motherboards, graphics cards, power supply units, SSDs, and prebuilt AI TOP PCs, delivering enterprise-grade performance right at your desktop.

...

The AI TOP Hardware is built with AI workloads in mind, including: - Multi-GPU configuration support for demanding tasks - Advanced cooling for sustained AI operations - Ultra-durable design with enterprise-grade endurance - Clustering capability for scalable computing
- Which AI TOP PC should I choose?

GIGABYTE offers AI TOP PCs to meet different needs: AI TOP 500: Our flagship, with up to 800GB total system memory, supporting models as large as 685B parameters. Scalable and built for advanced researchers and creators handling ultra-large fine-tuning and inference.

AI TOP 100: A balanced desktop-class solution with 160GB total system memory, supporting models up to 200B parameters. Versatile, customizable, and ready for both developers, gamers, and enterprise deployments.

AI TOP ATOM: Compact and efficient, delivering up to 1 petaFLOP of performance—ideal for entry-level developers and edge AI.

Note: Availability, specifications, and product appearance may vary by region. Please check with your local GIGABYTE representative for details.
